review.images: Eight project-specific Aldar Buildings 2 and 3 brochure renders show the park setting, entrance, apartment rooms and amenities. Removed duplicated and lifestyle stock imagery.
review.location: Aldar’s public launch page establishes the park setting. The cropped plan-view illustration is the full square project panel on physical penthouse brochure page 32. Tanami’s approximate estimates are listed separately. The Madena area pin and travel set place Yas Park several kilometres away, which conflicts with the official park setting and was excluded.
review.floorPlans: Nine original unit spreads on Buildings 2 and 3 brochure pages 26, 28, 30, 32, 35, 38, 40, 42 and 44. Madena-hosted Aldar layout pages 4 and 8 add the separately labelled 2 BR + maid Type C and 2 BR Type B. The remaining Madena unit layouts repeat official drawings. The official penthouse brochure page 33 prints 1,270 m². No unsourced apartment or duplex total areas.

unavailable: Signed apartment and duplex total areas, and confirmed building entrance coordinates.
